name: board-release
description: Azure DevOps extension that turns release Issue state changes into branches, PRs and release records.

scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path out
scripts.publish: npm run build && tfx extension publish --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --share-with dflat-websites --token $ADO_MARKETPLACE_PAT --output-path out
